Alex (support): FYI we just escalated a customer complaining about p95/p99 spikes when they enable tool calls + JSON schema validation. They see steady median but huge tail, reported after yesterday's runtime change.
Maria (eng-runtime): Ugh. Any request IDs or sample payloads?
Alex (support): Yes — sent logs in the ticket. Short summary: baseline generation latency ~120ms med, p95 ~350ms, p99 ~1.2s with tool/router enabled. When they toggle off tool routing or skip schema validation it drops to p99 ~420ms.
Sam (support): Customer is on Dedicated with small batch sizes (max_batch=8), region us-west-2. They said the router does an extra sync call per token sometimes.
Maria (eng-runtime): Can you paste the trace span IDs? Might be the tool router waiting on sync validation step.
Alex (support): Trace snippet copied from logs: ```trace_id=abc123 spans=[router.lookup:0.0004, schema.validate:0.0021, tool.call(wait):0.450, runtime.decode:0.0009, kv.fetch:0.0012, schema.validate:0.0025, tool.call(wait):0.430]```
Lei (eng-platform): Looks like two schema.validate + two tool.call waits interleaved — maybe validation is being applied both pre-router and post-insertion? Could be duplicate validation for streaming and final response.
Maria (eng-runtime): That matches a recent optimization I pushed — we added an extra safety validation after tool output. It was meant to be async but fell back to sync in some code paths when streaming was enabled.
Sam (support): Customer repro steps: 1) set model to rdx-medium-tool-enabled 2) enable streaming=true 3) provide tool schema with nested JSON 4) run 100 short prompts with concurrency=4.
Alex (support): They shared a minimal prompt plus tool schema. Example payload: ```json
{"input":"Get weather for 94105","tool_call":true,"tool_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"city":{"type":"string"},"zip":{"type":"string"}},"required":["zip"]}}
```
Maria (eng-runtime): Thanks. I can repro locally with streaming + validation sync fallback. p99 spikes when the router awaits validation before forwarding partial tokens.
Maria (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation options: 1) revert the post-tool sync validation to async/future-backed (cheap) 2) batch validation calls across requests (bigger) 3) short-term config toggle to disable redundant validation for streaming flows (fastest).
Lei (eng-platform): Can we ship a runtime flag scoped to Dedicated tenants? Toggle via customer config so only affected customers opt-in to the old behaviour.
Sam (support): Customer wants a short-term patch; prefer config toggle so they can flip it. Also asked for a mitigation timeline.
Maria (eng-runtime): I'll open a hotfix branch to change post-tool validation to async and expose a feature flag. ETA: PR today, can push to staging in ~3hrs, prod patch after QA in ~12hrs if green.
Alex (support): Great. Also customer asked for a repro script to validate after patch. Maria, can you add a small load script we can run? Sam will run it on their instance.
Maria (eng-runtime): Yep — add a script that fires 200 requests with streaming and tool router enabled. I'll include metrics collection for p50/p95/p99. Snippet: ```bash
for i in $(seq 1 200); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"input":"test","stream":true,"tool_schema":...}' & done; wait
```
Sam (support): Also adding monitoring dashboard quick links for the customer: route latency, schema validation durations, tool router wait time.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime/patch/async-schema-2165432100 to staging (sha:badc0ffee) :rocket:
Maria (eng-runtime): Running the staging job now. If staging looks good I'll schedule prod deploy with a short maintenance window.
Lei (eng-platform): For long term: we should instrument whether schema validation can be incremental and only validate diffs, plus add deterministic validators that are O(n) rather than reparsing JSON each time. I'll put a ticket.
Alex (support): Customer update message: "appreciate the quick response — can you enable toggle while you patch?" I'll coordinate.
Maria (eng-runtime): I enabled the config toggle for the customer's Dedicated project and pointed them to the shadow flag in Console (console.redwood.example/project/123/flags).
Sam (support): Asked customer to run their same load and send results.
Alex (support): Customer results: p99 dropped from ~1.2s to ~480ms after toggle. They're happy for now.
Maria (eng-runtime): Awesome. I'll proceed with the async hotfix and follow up. Creating follow-up tasks: - ensure streaming path never blocks on sync validation - add unit tests for tool call state machine - add telemetry to count validation sync fallbacks.
Lei (eng-platform): Adding a performance regression alert: if schema.validate > 50ms per request more than 1% of the time alert on eng-runtime paging.
Sam (support): Anything else we need to record in the ticket? I captured the before/after screenshots and raw traces.
Alex (support): Added notes and next steps. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maria (eng-runtime): I'll post the PR link when ready.
deploy-bot: deploy to staging succeeded (runtime/patch/async-schema-2165432100) :white_check_mark:
Maria (eng-runtime): PR #4823 opened: runtime: make post-tool JSON schema validation async + feature flag. Link: https://git.redwood.internal/p/runtime/pulls/4823
Alex (support): Closing the customer escalation after they confirm stable p99 on their tests.
Sam (support): Marking as resolved in tracker.
Maria (eng-runtime): Follow-up: I'll schedule the prod deploy tonight 02:00 UTC and notify oncall.
Lei (eng-platform): Noted. Also adding a postmortem-lite doc to capture root cause: sync fallback in streaming + duplicate validation.
Alex (support): Thanks team.
